bind_address.description: IP address the GQTP server will listen on (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only).

port.description: TCP port number for GQTP server communication.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

n_workers.description: Number of worker threads to handle incoming requests.

db_path.description: Path to the Groonga database file or directory (must be writable by the groonga user).

log.description: Enable or disable logging of server activity.

log_path.description: Path to the log file. Set to empty string to disable file logging (logs go to stdout/stderr).

compression.description: Enable or disable response compression to reduce bandwidth usage.

ssl.description: Enable or disable SSL/TLS encryption for GQTP connections (requires SSL-enabled Groonga build).

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format).

ssl_ca_cert_path.description: Optional path to CA certificate chain file for client certificate verification (leave empty to disable client auth).

items.description: A single extra command-line argument to pass directly to groonga_server_gqtp (e.g., '--enable-plugin', '--plugin-dir=/path/to/plugins').

extra_args.description: Additional arguments to pass to the GQTP server on startup (e.g., plugin options, security flags).
